datasets.name: SpaceX Inspiration4 Blood Serum (CMP, Immune & Cardiovascular)

data_quality_exclusions.race_based_egfr: Excluded outdated eGFR African American and Non-African American rows from analysis
data_quality_exclusions.sparse_ratios: BUN/creatinine ratio missing calculations flagged where uncalculated in original
data_quality_exclusions.sex_labels: Normalized markers while retaining original analyte label in raw_analyte
data_quality_exclusions.insufficient_baseline_rule: Minimum 2 valid preflight observations required for standard deviation and z-score calculations

disclaimer: Historical Inspiration4 research data — not live monitoring of current astronauts. Four anonymized civilian participants, approximately 3-day mission. Findings are research observations and cannot be generalized as clinical diagnoses.
